risks.title: Increased competitive intensity in Spain and key markets
risks.summary: Banco Santander operates in highly competitive markets, particularly in Spain where banking competition is intensifying. Pricing pressure and sector consolidation threaten margins, especially in retail banking due to fintech and digital neobanks.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit reference to 'Competition in Spain' (Section 9, p.979) in Item 1A. Moderate language but central strategic positioning. Stable trend but structural. High weight: core of geographic diversification model.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk and cyberattacks
risks.summary: Banco Santander faces growing risks from cyberattacks, data theft, and IT security incidents. The accelerated digitization of the banking model (digital bank with branches) increases exposure to cyber threats and breaches of sensitive customer data.
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity explicitly mentioned in Item 16.K (p.1016) and Item 5.E (p.509). Alert language: 'cyberattacks, data breaches, data losses' in forward-looking statements. Trend up: dedicated section in Risk management (Section 5, p.582). Critical weight: digital infrastructure is central.

risks.title: Dependence on banking regulation and capital requirements
risks.summary: Banco Santander operates under strict regulatory supervision (ECB, Spanish authorities) with increasing capital, liquidity, and compliance requirements. Regulatory changes, especially post-financial crisis, directly impact the group's profitability and operational flexibility.
risks.score_rationale: Supervision and regulation (Section 10, p.981) and Capital risk (Section 4, p.580) explicitly addressed. Strong language: 'regulatory capital and liquidity requirements' and 'greater regulation prompted by financial crises'. Stable trend but high structural weight for the sector.

risks.title: Credit risk and deterioration in portfolio quality
risks.summary: Banco Santander is exposed to credit default risk, collateral depreciation, and loan portfolio losses. Macroeconomic uncertainties (inflation, geopolitical tensions, economic slowdown) increase the likelihood of asset quality deterioration.
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk section (Section 2, p.556) detailed. Forward-looking statements mention 'potential losses from early loan repayment, collateral depreciation or counterparty risk'. Trend up: sensitivity to economic cycles. Major weight: core of banking activity.

risks.title: Political and geopolitical instability in operating regions
risks.summary: Banco Santander operates in regions exposed to political instability (Spain, Latin America, UK) and geopolitical tensions (Ukraine, Middle East). These risks affect regulatory stability, capital flows, and customer confidence.
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements explicitly cite 'political instability in Spain, the US, the UK, other European countries and Latin America' and 'war in Ukraine, uncertainties following the ceasefire agreement in the Middle East'. Trend up. High weight: multi-geographic presence.

risks.title: Technological transformation and reliance on IT systems
risks.summary: Banco Santander is making significant investments in AI, digital platforms, and the fintech ecosystem. Increasing reliance on complex IT systems creates risks of technological obsolescence, integration failures, and loss of competitiveness against digital pure-players.
risks.score_rationale: Section 7 'Technological innovation: artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and fintech ecosystem' (p.509) dedicated. Language of importance: 'digital bank with branches' and 'global platforms'. Trend up: AI and fintech accelerating. Strategic weight: model transformation.

risks.title: Reputational risk and loss of stakeholder trust
risks.summary: Banco Santander faces reputational risks related to financial scandals, unfair business practices, or compliance failures. Loss of trust from customers, investors, and regulators could significantly impact group value and market access.
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements mention 'reputational risk and potential adverse reactions of stakeholders, including adverse effects on the market price of our securities'. Stable trend but high sensitivity. Major weight: highly reputational financial sector.

risks.title: Compliance risk and money laundering
risks.summary: Banco Santander must comply with strict anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) standards. Compliance failures expose the group to substantial regulatory fines, legal proceedings, and reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: Compliance risk (Section 6, p.588) has a dedicated section. Implicit alert language: 'Business conduct' (Governance information, p.93). Trend up: strengthening of AML/KYC standards. High weight: highly scrutinized sector.
